purpose: Blank Phase 0 evidence collection intake only; no VIN, scores or assessed vehicle results
prohibited_shortcuts: no catalyst bypass/removal as a diagnostic shortcut
no attempt to crank a suspected seized/hydrolocked/oil-starved engine
no hot radiator cap opening or running overheated engine
no dry road test on unsafe subframe/brake/fuel system
no unauthorized module resets or ECU/TCM programming
no guessing converter part, shaft tolerance or VIN fitment

fields.label: Seller reason for not running, last start/run, what tests concluded and who performed them
fields.requires: seller written explanation, date of last successful start, diagnosis invoice
fields.stop_if: any uncertain major mechanical failure or vague 'easy fix' => evidence insufficient

fields.label: Actual vehicle VIN/model year, engine B235/B207, gear family and emissions market
fields.requires: privately collected VIN and original engine/gearbox tags with manufacturer identity provenance
fields.stop_if: missing/wrong identity prevents part and fluid decisions

fields.label: History of overheating, oil warning, coolant loss, knock, hydrolock or timing failure
fields.requires: seller records, tow/repair invoices, historic photos, chronological account
fields.stop_if: prior seizure or fluid ingestion => do not crank

fields.label: Prior structural/brake/emissions inspection failures and rust photos
fields.requires: recent original inspection result or qualified shop estimate
fields.stop_if: severe suspension rust, leaking hydraulics or unresolved fuel leaks => no road test

fields.label: Rear subframe, pickup structure, front mount, fuel/brake lines, lifting points
fields.requires: safe external photographs or professional lift inspection, actual qualified evaluation
fields.stop_if: suspected unsafe lift point or load-bearing structure => no under-car DIY

fields.label: Visible fluids, contaminated oil/coolant, tank lines, hot/exhaust damage
fields.requires: passive cold visual assessment performed without engine start or opening pressurized systems
fields.stop_if: visible fuel leak, milky fluids, absent lubrication or coolant evidence => no start

fields.label: Location and cause of allegedly clogged exhaust/catalytic converter
fields.requires: original repair diagnosis, converter location/part photo, documented test method and upstream history
fields.stop_if: unconfirmed physical restriction or persistent misfire => do not assume converter-only repair

fields.label: Stored ECM/TCM trouble codes and freeze frames without clearing
fields.requires: read-only scan, model-specific Tech2 available or timestamped original shop report
fields.stop_if: no DTC does not prove mechanical condition; clearing/resetting without records unacceptable

fields.label: Actual T7/T8 control module software and hardware, gearbox TCM and prior swaps
fields.requires: original Tech2 read-only vehicle system information and records
fields.stop_if: unknown software/immobilizer mismatch prevents donor ECU/TCM part approval

fields.label: Can qualified mechanic certify safe controlled crank/rotation with no seizure/fluid-ingestion risk?
fields.requires: technician judgement after preliminary exterior, timing and fluid check
fields.stop_if: any seizure, hydrolock, oil starvation, or severe overheating concern => stop

fields.label: Per-cylinder compression and leakdown at factory-correct conditions
fields.requires: factory-controlled test for exact engine/year if safe to crank
fields.stop_if: confirmed below-spec internal condition => major engine risk, specialist quote

fields.label: Engine oil pressure under original year/temperature/test-oil and RPM conditions
fields.requires: qualified warmed running-engine gauge results, exact procedure and instrument conditions
fields.stop_if: if non-running => unavailable, never infer from oil warning lamp

fields.label: Is the restriction physically verified and at which upstream/downstream point?
fields.requires: qualified appropriate US/CA in-scope exhaust restriction test and cause investigation
fields.stop_if: historic non-US Tech2 bulletin not US/Canada authorization; nonrunner cannot run test

fields.label: Boost bypass actuator leak, charged hose and mechanical compressor damage
fields.requires: factory year-specific safe leak test and documented professional physical component examination
fields.stop_if: no GT17/TD04 calibrated shaft value recovered; whistle or P1105 alone not replacement proof

fields.label: Gearbox fluid, sensor codes, commanded/actual gear/slip and internal mechanical confirmation
fields.requires: correct year/installed FA57/AF40 identification, qualified static/roadworthy professional tests if safe
fields.stop_if: nonrunning and not load-testable => gearbox mechanical condition unknown; no stall test

fields.label: Actual structural, engine, transmission, exhaust, brakes, tow/storage estimates separately
fields.requires: dated itemized professional written quotes and OEM VIN-specific parts
fields.stop_if: an unspecified major repair is not $0 and does not satisfy DIY no-rebuild objective
